page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. Running on a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 52 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, meaning hyperthreading is disabled to ensure dedicated compute resources per vCPU. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for operating systems and data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The absence of bundled local storage and GPU hardware makes this server specialized for non-graphical workloads that rely on network-attached storage.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation provides predictable CPU performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or hyperthreaded environments. The balanced memory-to-CPU ratio makes the ecs.re6p.13xlarge suitable for general-purpose enterprise workloads, multi-threaded application servers, batch processing, and database deployments that require consistent compute power.
